articles.title: SEC Publishes Updated Market Statistics, Highlighting Increase in IPOs and Proceeds Raised
articles.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission’s Division of Economic and Risk Analysis (DERA) published updated statistics and data visualizations covering key segments of the U.S. capital markets, including a notable increase in the number of initial public…

articles.title: US stablecoin adoption could surge with bank-like protections: Visa survey
articles.description: The survey released by Visa posited that bank-like protections for stablecoins could increase adoption in the US as companies are preparing for the enactment of the GENIUS Act.

articles.title: Borrow Against Your Bitcoin at a Fixed Rate: Coinbase Expands Morpho Loans
articles.description: The product lets users lock in their rate and repayment date when borrowing USDC against Bitcoin, marking the first enterprise-scale deployment of Morpho Midnight and a shift away from on-chain lending's variable-rate norm.

articles.title: Meta's Muse reignites AI disruption fears. Traders are targeting this brokerage stock as next casualty
articles.description: Meta's latest consumer AI product is sending such big shockwaves through the market that it's even inflaming a long-time rivalry in the brokerage business.

articles.title: White House adviser defends President Trump's crypto ties in wake of Clarity Act defeat
articles.description: President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, accused Democrats of unfairly amplifying Trump's crypto ties as a political weapon.

articles.title: New Social Security bill would lower retirement age to 60 for some workers
articles.description: Rep. Haley Stevens introduced a bill that would let some workers in physically demanding jobs claim full Social Security retirement benefits at age 60.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield leaps to fresh 19-year high after hot economic readings
articles.description: Treasury yields traded higher on Wednesday as new services and manufacturing sector data increased worry of further Federal Reserve rate hikes.

articles.title: Trump-Xi summit puts AI safety talks on the table but neither side wants to slow down
articles.description: Recent weeks have seen AI safety fears reach new heights. That will be a key focus for the U.S. and Chinese leaders, analysts told CNBC.

articles.title: Iran's president blames U.S., Israel for global instability in defiant UN speech
articles.description: Pezeshkian began his address to the U.N. General Assembly in New York City by holding up photos of children he said were killed by U.S. and Israeli bombs.

articles.title: Federal prosecutors probe Jeffrey Epstein estate executors, WSJ reports
articles.description: A group that advocates for Epstein victims applauded the news that Richard Kahn and Darren Indyke are facing an investigation. No charges have been been filed.

articles.title: Crypto Exchange That Invented 100x Leverage Is No More: Here’s What BitMEX Users Need to Know
articles.description: BitMEX ended trading at 04:00 UTC Wednesday and is urging users to withdraw their remaining funds, as fees now apply to balances left on the exchange.

articles.title: McDonald's CEO expects high inflation, fewer diner visits are here to stay
articles.description: McDonald's CEO Chris Kempczinski said that he expects that high inflation and flat traffic will continue to weigh on the restaurant industry.

articles.title: McDonald's stock falls as it unveils plan to spend big on restaurant upgrades
articles.description: The plans are part of the fast-food giant's new growth strategy, called McDonald's > NEXT.

articles.title: Canada's Six Biggest Banks Team Up on a Shared Digital-Dollar Network
articles.description: RBC, TD, BMO, Scotiabank, CIBC and National Bank are jointly exploring a Canadian-dollar tokenized deposit system, starting with transfers between the banks themselves.

articles.title: Trump faces Xi as strains with allies complicate U.S. pressure on China
articles.description: As Trump prepares to meet Xi, strains with U.S. allies are complicating Washington’s efforts to marshal pressure against an increasingly resilient China.

articles.title: NYSE Taps Blockchain.com to Reach Crypto Investors With Tokenized Stocks
articles.description: Blockchain.com and NYSE Group signed a preliminary agreement to give the crypto exchange's users access to tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, pending regulatory approval.

articles.title: Activist Toms Capital urges Devon Energy in letter to explore alternatives, including a sale
articles.description: Toms, which manages just over $4 billion in assets, says in the letter it is now one of Devon's top five shareholders.

articles.title: Bitwise launches first Lighter ETP amid Hyperliquid rivalry
articles.description: The product gives European investors brokerage access to the LIT token as Bitwise expands its lineup of products tied to decentralized derivatives platforms.

articles.title: Americans Would Use Stablecoins—If They Came With Bank Protections, Visa Study Finds
articles.description: A Visa survey found U.S. willingness to use stablecoins for cross-border transfers rises from 36% to 56% when paired with hypothetical bank-level fraud protection and deposit insurance.

articles.title: Meta is having a ChatGPT moment with Muse. What is it and what makes it so special
articles.description: The tech world and Wall Street are abuzz with Meta's new AI agent ahead of CEO Mark Zuckerberg's developers conference keynote.
